title: Romanian Deadlift
summary: A hip hinge that lowers the bar down your legs with soft knees, putting a long stretch on the hamstrings.

setup.text: Stand tall holding the bar at your hips, with your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and let the bar slide down your thighs, keeping your back flat.
Go down until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, usually around mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

form_cues.cue: Keep the bar close to your legs
Stop at a deep hamstring stretch and stand up
The movement is hips back, not bending down. Your knee angle barely changes.

mistakes.text: Rounding the back to reach the bar lower.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where you can fail a rep safely, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
